name: If My Con Had Fusion
source:
Your first convention. See a anime convention through the eyes of a first timer. Follow Fuu-chan as she embarks on her own otaku adventure and learns the ins and outs of proper convention behaviour and hopefully makes a few friends along the way.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
你的第一次漫展。以初次参加者的视角，体验一场动漫展会。跟随Fuu酱踏上属于她的御宅族冒险，了解参加漫展的各种礼仪，也希望能在途中交上几个朋友。

[摘自Itch.io]
